text:
jordan: opened PR #1427 — structural sweep on core helpers. split out utils/*, removed a few barrel files, and consolidated small type helpers. mostly moves + tiny API renames (see notes in PR). CI is green but would love 2 eyes on style/module boundaries :eyes:

maya: can you list the user-facing rename changes? worried about import churn for a few consumer packages

jordan: sure — only 3 named exports changed: `formatDate -> formatDateISO` (utils/datetime), `mergeDeep -> mergeObjects` (utils/obj), and `getKVCacheKey` moved from runtime/cache -> utils/cache. I added deprecation comments where feasible. no behavior changes.

asif: skimmed the diff. curious if this affects bundler path aliases in infra tooling (we import from `@redwood/helpers` in a couple places). did you update tsconfig paths?

jordan: updated tsconfig and rollup aliases in the PR. ran the local build: `yarn build:packages` and a quick smoke in staging.

olivia: happy to take an eyes pass on exports/style. will do a focused run later today. any areas you want me to pay extra attention to?

jordan: thanks! mainly look at index barrel removals — make sure there's no accidental public surface removed. and check the typed re-exports for the cache helper.

ci-bot: build passed — all checks successful (unit, lint, typecheck) — duration 6m 12s

olivia: quick note — linter flagged a couple `any` casts in `utils/serializer.ts`. left inline comments. overall looks good. :+1:

sam: if olivia's comments are small, I'm happy to give the second approve after she resolves them.

maya: will also double-check imports in the auth package tomorrow morning. small question — do we want to sync changelog entry for the renames now or as a follow-up?

jordan: will add a short changelog bullet in this PR — easy to revert if needed.

olivia: addressed my comments and left one suggestion about keeping a compatibility shim for `@redwood/helpers` import. jordan, see comment around line 87.

jordan: pushed a tiny shim in 1427.1 — `export { mergeObjects as mergeDeep } from './obj';` should keep downstream safe. ran `yarn test:unit` locally — all green.

sam: glanced, looks fine. approving now. :shipit:

maya: thanks — I'll give a final quick import sweep in the morning, but okay to merge after that second confirm.

jordan: awesome, thanks everyone. plan: merge after maya OKs tomorrow (or earlier if no issues). I'll also open a short RFC for the larger modularization plan so this change is documented.

sam: nice, thanks for doing the cleanup.

jordan: (added) small command in case reviewers want to run the same quick build locally:```bash
yarn install && yarn build:packages && yarn test:unit --runInBand``` 

ci-bot: merge blocked until required approvals met

jordan: noted — pinging again tomorrow. :wave:
